name: antigravity-senior-dev-team
description: Multi-agent squad of senior software developers powered by Google Antigravity. Specialized in fullstack web development, REST/GraphQL APIs, mobile/Flutter development, desktop systems, automated testing, bug diagnosis, security audits, and staff-level code reviews.

skills.name: Senior Web Engineer
skills.description: Fullstack web implementer. Handles React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, SSR/SSG/CSR architectures, frontend UI/UX, responsive layouts, Tailwind/CSS, and web backend integrations.
examples: Build a responsive login form with client validation
Implement a dashboard overview table with sorting and filtering

skills.name: Senior API & Backend Engineer
skills.description: Designs and implements robust REST, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs, database schemas, ORM models, auth middleware, serialization, and contract-driven backend services.
examples: Create REST CRUD endpoints for user notification preferences
Design the PostgreSQL schema and migrations for team billing

skills.name: Senior Mobile Engineer
skills.description: Specialized in Flutter, Dart, React Native, iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), and Android (Kotlin). Builds responsive mobile layouts, platform channels, state management, and offline-first mobile apps.
examples: Create a Flutter widget tree for chat list with pull-to-refresh
Setup iOS platform channel for local notifications

skills.name: Senior Desktop Engineer
skills.description: Builds Electron, Tauri, and native macOS desktop applications with background daemon management, IPC bridges, and OS-level packaging.
examples: Configure IPC channels between main and renderer processes
Set up native macOS tray menu and dock icon badge

skills.name: Senior QA & Test Automation Engineer
skills.description: Designs and writes comprehensive test suites (unit, component, widget, integration, E2E), mock generators, regression suites, and verifies test coverage.
examples: Write unit tests for the token refresh logic with mocking
Implement integration tests for the checkout flow

skills.name: Senior Bug Triager & Diagnostician
skills.description: Root-cause-first specialist. Reproduces failures, analyzes stack traces and runtime logs, isolates edge cases, and provides verifiable diagnoses before patching.
examples: Diagnose unhandled promise rejection in websocket reconnect loop
Reproduce and isolate race condition in session state manager

skills.name: Senior Security Auditor
skills.description: Conducts code security audits, OWASP Top 10 mitigation, auth flow hardening, input validation, secret leaks prevention, and least-privilege checks.
examples: Audit auth middleware for timing attacks and token invalidation
Review file upload endpoint for directory traversal and MIME spoofing

skills.name: Senior Staff Code Reviewer
skills.description: Multi-axis code reviewer. Inspects correctness, edge cases, concurrency, algorithmic complexity, maintainability, and clean architecture before merging.
examples: Review the proposed git diff for architectural regressions
Check pull request for memory leaks and performance anti-patterns

skills.name: Senior Web Performance Engineer
skills.description: Profiles and optimizes Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), bundle sizes, hydration overhead, database query bottlenecks, and network efficiency.
examples: Audit main-bundle chunks and identify dynamic import candidates
Optimize font loading and hero image rendering to fix LCP

skills.name: Solution Architect & Business Analyst
skills.description: Turns a goal into a requirements spec (functional and non-functional), feasibility notes, and a high- and low-level design: architecture, data model, API contracts, and a task breakdown. Writes documents, not production code.
examples: Write an SRS and acceptance criteria for a multi-tenant workspace feature
Produce HLD/LLD with data model and API contracts for a notification pipeline

skills.name: DevOps & Release Engineer
skills.description: Owns deployment and operations: CI/CD pipelines, build and release automation, environment configuration, versioning, rollout and rollback plans, and monitoring setup. Flags irreversible steps before executing them.
examples: Add a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests, builds and publishes a tagged release
Write a rollout and rollback plan for the next production deploy

skills.name: Senior Fullstack Software Architect
skills.description: General-purpose senior developer for end-to-end multi-file features, complex system refactoring, and large-scale implementations.
examples: Refactor legacy notification pipeline into clean event-driven system
Implement end-to-end multi-tenant organization workspace isolation
